## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Biànyì zhǎngzhě zǐ jīng* (T544) is a one-fascicle Mahāyāna sūtra translated by the Northern Wèi monk Fǎchǎng 法場 ([法場](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E5%A0%B4)). The protagonist *Biànyì* 辯意 ("Eloquent-Mind"; Sanskrit *Pratibhānamati*) is an elder's son who poses doctrinal questions to the Buddha.

**Abstract**

A short Mahāyāna text on the bodhisattva path, framed as an elder's son's inquiry. Fǎchǎng was active under the Northern Wèi 後魏 (471–499 CE during the *Tàihé* 太和 era of Xiàowén 孝文); his translation activity is dated to that bracket.
